_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil; canceling impulses and missing 2019 thrust factors give no clean breaker to leave Hope.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: both non-bullish, but analyst explicit HOLD/coil vs narrative distribution lean without a forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range-bound, funding near flat, fear_greed 55-70, no ETF-flow or momentum impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed <50 on fast sell with exchange inflows, or momentum/funding reheat to 2019 mini-top profile with spot ETF inflows on
